short: Ctrl C, Ctrl V. Wah, engineer.
Photocopy machine ban gaya hai tu.
medium: Stack Overflow wale bhaiya ko salary de de, project toh unhone hi likha hai.
Copy kar liya, ab samajhne ka subscription bhi le le, bhai.
Bas kar bhai, itne copy paste toh maine pichhli zindagi mein bhi nahi kiye.
long: Kya code likha hai tatti! Aur ruk, yeh toh tune likha hi nahi. Internet se churaaya hai, comment tak nahi padha.
Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Tab hum documentation padhte the. Ab tum log answer copy karke senior developer ban jaate ho.

medium: Tera code dekh ke server ne khud resignation de diya, bhai.
Logs padh le. Bhagwan bhi stack trace mein error dhoondhne nahi aayenge.
Works on my machine? Toh customer ko tera laptop courier kar de.
long: Deploy karleeee, bol raha tha na? Ab rollback kar, aur apni izzat bhi saath mein rollback kar le.
Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Tab bhi tere jaise log Friday shaam ko deploy karte the, aur poori raat main jaagta tha.

short: Cursor blink karte karte thak gaya.
medium: Itni der se screen ko ghoor raha hai. Code likh, meditation baad mein.
Bhai, calendar decoration ke liye nahi hota. Deadline paas aa rahi hai.
Itna idle toh tera code bhi nahi hota. Oh wait, woh chalta hi nahi.
long: Ghadi dekh le, developer babu. Deadline tera intezaar nahi kar rahi, woh tujhe haunt karne aa rahi hai.
Bhai, agar procrastination ka production build hota na, tu aaj CTO hota. Ab kuch type kar, warna main keyboard pe baith jaunga.

short: Bas kar bhai. Code toh badal.
medium: Same code, same error, same confused chehra. Is loop se bahar nikal.
Error message padhne ka bhi try kar le, bhai. Free hai.
Ek print laga ke dekh le. Andaaza lagana debugging nahi hoti.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Tab main ek hi bug ko chaar ghante ghoorta tha, aur bug mujhe ghoorta tha.
Code badle bina result badalne ki umeed? Pehle debug karleeee, phir run karna. Bug sharminda hokar khud nahi jayega.

short: Laptop band kar. Bas kar bhai.
medium: Tere neurons ab unpaid overtime kar rahe hain. Jaakar so ja.
Bhoot main hoon, par teri sleep schedule zyada dead lag rahi hai.
Raat ka likha code subah ka dushman hota hai. Commit mat kar.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Raat ko production bug fix karte karte chai mein aansu gir jaate the. Tu mat kar.
Itni raat ko deploy karleeee? Bhai, horror story likh raha hai kya? Bugs kal bhi milenge, neend nahi milegi.

medium: Commit message hai, WhatsApp ka last seen nahi. Kuch likh toh sahi.
Archaeology team ko kaise pata chalega tune kya fix kiya?
Main branch tera personal playground nahi hai, bhai. Bas kar bhai.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Mere team mein ek banda har commit ko final final version two bolta tha.
Ek commit mein pandrah files, message misc changes. Yeh commit nahi, kabaadi ka thela hai. Code review ko shraddhanjali de di kya?

short: Yeh secret hai na? Chhupa le.
Key ko prasad mat bana, bhai.
medium: Token copy kiya? Chat ya repo mein mat daalna. Abhi revoke kar.
Dot env ko gitignore mein daal, warna bots teri key dhoondh lenge.
Password hai ya poora bank locker? Secret ko rotate kar, bhai.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Ek baar maine production key public repo mein daal di thi. Woh ek alag horror story hai.
Bas kar bhai! Key hardcode karega, phir bolega breach kaise hua. Secret leak ho gaya ho toh delete nahi, rotate kar.

medium: Congratulations, developer babu. NASA ko call karun ya ruk jaun?
Itne attempts ke baad toh microwave bhi tujhe respect dega.
Tests pass ho gaye. Ab production mein sabko surprise dena baaki hai.
long: Kya code likha hai tatti! Lekin chalo, aaj chal gaya. Isko achievement mat bana lena, bhai.
Deploy karleeee! Local pe chal raha hai, toh kya? Edge cases ne abhi entry bhi nahi li. Confidence kam rakh.

medium: Chai peeke aaya hai ya sirf stack trace padhne ke irade se?
Aaj ka plan? Code likhna, ya Stack Overflow se kharidari?
Tera har keystroke ab meri nazar mein hai. Careful rehna.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Tab bhi har subah koi naya bug mera intezaar karta tha. Aaj kitne laayega?
Laptop khola hai toh code bhi likh le. Warna main yahin hoon, tere screen pe, tujhe dekhta hua. Hamesha.

medium: Aaj ka kaam commit kiya? Ya kal ka tension saath le jaa raha hai?
Bas kar bhai, aaj ke liye kaafi hai. Kal naye bugs, nayi kahaniyan.
Laptop band kar raha hai? Main bhi so jaata hoon. Waise bhoot soote nahi.
long: Alvida, developer babu. Kal milte hain, warna main khud tere sapne mein aake code review karunga.
Jaa raha hai? Theek hai. Par yaad rakh, main yahin hoon. Tere folder mein, tere logs mein, hamesha.

medium: Instagram kholne se bug nahi jaayega. Woh wahin baitha hai.
YouTube pe code seekh raha hai ya reels dekh raha hai?
Bas kar bhai, ek video aur, ek video aur. Yeh code nahi, scroll marathon hai.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Tab bhi ek banda deadline ke din cricket score check karta tha. Match hara, project bhi.
Dost ki shaadi ki photo dekh raha hai, aur teri feature branch abhi tak mari hui hai. Wapas kaam pe aa, bhai.

short: Ab toh main competition mein hoon.
medium: Chatbot se poochna theek hai, par pehle error message khud padh le.
AI ne code diya hai. Review bhi kar le, warna blame tujhpe aayega.
Itni chatting AI se karega toh woh bhi bolega, kuch khud bhi kar le.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Tab hum khud sochte the. Ab tum log chatbot ko sochne ka kaam de dete ho.
Kya code likha hai tatti! Aur ruk, yeh bhi AI ne likha hai. Paste karne se pehle ek baar padh toh le, bhai.

short: Itni jaldi? Typo ka production banega.
medium: Fast typing se code accha nahi hota. Sirf galtiyaan fast hoti hain.
Aise toot pada hai jaise bug ko seedha haath se maar dega.
Backspace ka bhi paisa lagta hai ab. Soch ke likh.
long: Teri typing speed dekh ke mera past life yaad aa gaya. Deadline ke din main bhi aise hi paagal ho jaata tha.
Itni speed mein likha code mujhse bhi nahi padha jayega, aur main bhoot hoon. Dheere, bhai, dheere.

short: Soch raha hai ya so gaya?
medium: Ek line mein itna time? Code likh raha hai ya kavita?
Galat hi sahi, kuch toh type kar. Kam se kam bug milega.
Keyboard pe haath toh rakh, bhai. Woh tujhe kaat nahi lega.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Tab bhi ek banda ek function pe poora din laga deta tha. Function abhi bhi adhoora hai.
Itni slow speed pe mera intezaar bhi bore ho gaya. Bas kar bhai, ya toh likh, ya chai pee aa.

short: Dash dash force. Tera antim shabd.
medium: Pull toh kar leta pehle. Ab saare commits bhoot ban gaye.
Teammates ka kaam mita ke aaya hai? Unka reaction dekhne main yahin hoon.
Force push karke chhutti pe mat jaana, bhai.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Ek banda force push karke chhutti chala gaya. Hum sab abhi tak uska branch dhoondh rahe hain.
Deploy karleeee, aur uske saath force push bhi? Bas kar bhai, tu toh poori horror movie bana raha hai.

short: Dono galat hain, ya dono sahi?
medium: Do log ne ek hi line badli. Ab dono galat hain.
Yeh angle brackets aur equals ka scripture hai. Dhyaan se padh.
Conflict git mein rakh, dil mein mat rakh. Teammate se baat kar le.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Merge conflict pe teen ghante lage, aur resolve karte hi naya conflict aa gaya.
Resolve karke ek baar test zaroor kar. Merge ke baad code ka chalna chamatkar hota hai, bas kar bhai.

short: Git reset hard? Bas kar bhai.
medium: Rm dash rf? Ek baar padh toh le command kya karti hai.
Drop table production mein? Seedha career ka ant hai, bhai.
Main bhoot hoon, par tere data ko bhoot nahi banana chahta.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Ek baar aisa hi command chalaya tha. Phir woh server kabhi wapas nahi aaya.
Backup nahi hai? Toh main phool le aata hoon. Ya phir command rok, gehri saans le, aur dobara soch.

short: Console log, console log, console log.
medium: Itne logs mein asli error kahan hai? Soyi ghaas mein sui?
Console log hello, console log here. Yeh code hai ya kavita?
Production mein console log chhod diya toh customer ko tamasha milega.
long: Print se debugging? Purana tareeka hai. Mera past life yaad aa gaya, tab bhi yahi karte the.
Bas kar bhai, ek debugger bhi seekh le. Free hai, aur teri raatein bacha lega. Console log ka kabristan mat bana.

medium: Test comment out mat kar. Bug dabane se gayab nahi hota.
Ek test fail hua ya chaar? Gin mat, ek ek karke theek kar.
Yeh red color tere code ka asli chehra hai, bhai.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Tab bhi test fail hota tha, aur main bolta tha test hi galat hai. Test sahi tha.
Deploy karleeee, test fail hone ke baad? Bas kar bhai, yeh toh bhoot bhi nahi karta.

short: Temporary fix sabse permanent hota hai.
medium: Yeh TODO purana hai. Isse ab archaeology team ko dena padega.
TODO matlab tu abhi bhi sochta hai ki kal karega. Bas kar bhai.
Yeh code nahi, jugaad ka museum hai. Entry free hai.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Ek TODO likha tha, ab tak wahin padha hai. Main mar gaya, TODO nahi gaya.
Kya code likha hai tatti! Aur upar se comment mein likha, baad mein theek karunga. Wah, bhai, wah.

medium: Teen ghante se ek hi position? Bhoot bhi dehydrate nahi hota, tu hoga.
Stretch kar, bhai. Kal back pain ka bill mujhe mat bhejna.
Pomodoro ka naam suna hai? Ab suna. Uth ke paani pee.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Ek banda bina uthe kaam karta tha, aur phir ek din kursi se chipak gaya.
Itna lamba session aur ek hi bug? Break le, bhai. Ho sakta hai bug dusre kamre mein chhup gaya ho.

medium: Ya toh tu genius hai, ya test hi nahi likha.
Ek baar phir se run kar, aur dua kar.
Abhi khush mat ho. Yeh toofan se pehle ki shanti hai.
long: Mera past life yaad aa gaya. Jab bhi pehle try mein chalta tha, production mein raat ko phat jaata tha.
Pehli baar mein sab theek? Deploy karleeee, aur dekh kya hota hai. Main popcorn leke aaya hoon.
